summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quote Management System. Fixed critical bug in duplicate endpoint (MongoDB ObjectId serialization). All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly including quote creation, listing, status management, and duplication.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <tbody> - minor console warning, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: POST /api/quotes/{id}/duplicate was returning MongoDB _id causing 500 error - added new_quote.pop('_id', None) before return
All Quote CRUD endpoints properly implemented with authentication
Quote status flow working: draft -> sent -> accepted/rejected
Quote duplication creates new quote with new quote_number and draft status
Stats cards correctly calculate totals for each status
VAT calculation working correctly with multiple rates (0%, 1%, 10%, 20%)
Payment terms dropdown has all options (Peşin, Vadeli 15/30/45/60, Taksit 3/6/12)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed quotes during testing. Existing quote TKL-000001 verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quote Management System fully tested and working. Backend tests cover: GET /api/quotes (list with status filter), POST /api/quotes (create with items and VAT calculation), GET /api/quotes/{id} (single quote), PATCH /api/quotes/{id} (update subject, status changes draft->sent->accepted/rejected), POST /api/quotes/{id}/duplicate (creates copy with new number), DELETE /api/quotes/{id}. Frontend tests verified: Quote list page with stats cards (Toplam Teklif, Taslak, Gönderilen, Kabul Edilen, Kabul Edilen Toplam), quote cards with action buttons (view, copy, delete), status change buttons (Gönderildi for draft, Accept/Reject for sent), Quote create page with customer select, payment terms, validity days, item add/remove, VAT calculation, print preview.

bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one() adds _id field to the document, which is an ObjectId and not JSON serializable
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added new_quote.pop('_id', None) before returning the response in duplicate_quote endpoint
